success.description: A shadowy owl settles on your shoulder and proceeds to advise you in a voice that only you can hear. The owl’s observations add {Dc} to Charm, Discipline, Guile, Intimidate, and Leadership checks. The owl stays with you until the end of the episode or sunrise, whichever comes first.

As above and, if you also have the Owl of Wisdom on your shoulder, Willpower and Toughness are each increased by 1 while in the presence of those you know to be lawbreakers, oathbreakers, or destroyers of knowledge.

sigmarsComet.description: You may recharge your Owl of Wisdom blessing.

conservative.requirements: 8 favour. You must have a piece of food an owl would like to eat. Sigils. This card recharges at sunrise.
conservative.name: Owl of Judgement
